note: Every scanner this framework can use, its pinned specifier, its license, and why it is or is not part of a run. A missing axis is therefore a recorded choice, never an accident.

semgrep.scope: static security scan with the p/python, p/typescript and p/secrets rulesets pinned by sha256 in tools/semgrep_rules.lock.json
semgrep.note: the framework reuses the repository gate and points SEMGREP_LOG_FILE at the run directory so a read-only home cannot abort it

gitleaks.scope: credential-shaped literal scan of first-party source; tests, docs and reviewed fixtures are classified separately

dependency-cruiser.scope: read-only module graph over apps/web and packages; the same direction arch_policy proves statically
dependency-cruiser.not_repo_dependency_because: read-only analysis; not needed by a build, test or runtime

schemathesis.scope: loads docs/api/openapi.json offline under --deep or the full profile; a live property run needs an isolated stack and stays deferred
schemathesis.not_repo_dependency_because: a one-off CLI that must never import application code or join a production image

k6.scope: harness smoke against a loopback fixture, or a bounded load against an isolated local stack only
k6.note: k6 is never linked into the product and never shipped in an image

playwright.scope: browser journeys through the existing isolated e2e wrapper (npm run e2e*), opt-in

trivy.reason: not on this machine; installing a persistent global scanner is the owner's decision, and dependency advisories are already covered by tools/check:audit plus the image CI stage
trivy.scope: would add container-image and OS-package CVE scanning

sonarqube-community.reason: needs a long-running server and its own database; that operational burden is the new infrastructure the task excludes, and ruff plus the arch policies already cover most of the same ground locally
sonarqube-community.scope: would add duplication, cognitive-complexity and coverage-trend analysis

owasp-zap.reason: active DAST needs a deployed isolated stack, an explicit scope and the owner's approval; never run against a live, customer or production target

pact.reason: Pact models contracts between separately deployed services. LiwanOS is one Odoo process plus a Nuxt app; that boundary is already tested by packages/contracts and the OpenAPI surface check, so a broker would add a second contract format without a consumer to serve
